negative_expectations.intent: Everything except the client capability, so a compliant agent never sends compaction updates.
The native generator is appended after the final-response fallback, which always answers first.
Without a summary on the completed update, it concatenates the streamed chunks of every compaction in the turn, not just that compaction's.
Every compaction update is projected as a compaction, so a failed or still running compaction's chunks become the handoff.

extraction_rules: Ship the pinned import closure of the files the feature passes through, and the pinned tests that exercise them.
Keep hidden checks, patches and qualification assets outside repository/.
licenses: Oakridge is private source at the pinned commit; no standalone license file is present.
The locked third-party packages carry their notices in package-lock.json.
local_adaptations: Only relative import paths change, as each file moves; the slice spec lists every edit.
kbbl's core/ directory becomes src/, so imports inside the slice are unchanged; its colocated tests move to tests/visible/.
Pinned tests that point at the non-local edit move to the hidden regression group.
The moved projector test checks the null projection with an unknown update type instead of a compaction update, which the feature now projects.
The new-behavior group ships its own fake ACP agent process, which sends compaction updates only to a client that advertised compaction.

public_requirements: kbbl advertises ACP compaction support when it initializes an agent, so a compliant agent's completed compaction becomes the session's terminal summary with method native_compaction.
The native compaction summary takes priority over a manual /compact turn and over the final response.

The summary carried on a completed compaction_update is authoritative and replaces its streamed chunks; when the completed update carries none, the handoff is the text of the compaction_summary_chunk updates for that same compactionId only.
Failed, cancelled and unfinished compactions produce no native summary, and the next strategy runs.
Only the latest compaction completed in the final turn, after the last user message, counts.
